purpose: Read-only VPS, Docker, Paperclip, and proxy forensic command packet. Maps every approved command to (a) why it is read-only, (b) what it proves, and (c) which hypothesis it supports or refutes. Also enumerates forbidden commands with rationale. Built from S01 runtime truth map and the HANDOFF_PAPERCLIP_RUNTIME_FORENSICS handoff checklist.
scope: read-only inspection only. No SSH, no remote execution in T01. T02 will execute the approved packet only after explicit user confirmation.

trigger_conditions: any change to M014-S01 truth map vps_targets
any change to HANDOFF_PAPERCLIP_RUNTIME_FORENSICS Next Action commands
any change to the safe-restart command in PAPERCLIP_SANDBOX_TESTING_HANDOFF.md
any GSD memory entry tagged Paperclip-runtime-stability affecting VPS contract

vps_targets_mirror.safe_restart_command: cd /opt/paperclip-sandbox/docker && docker compose -p paperclip_sandbox --env-file /opt/paperclip-sandbox/.env.sandbox -f docker-compose.quickstart.yml -f /opt/paperclip-sandbox/docker-compose.sandbox-override.yml up -d --no-build paperclip
vps_targets_mirror.source_rule: Mirror of truth map vps_targets + HANDOFF_PAPERCLIP_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.md sandbox contract. S02 T02 must NOT deviate from these paths/commands.

preconditions: explicit user confirmation for VPS read-only inspection recorded in T02
SSH access to VPS 87.99.146.178 as non-root operator OR root with sudo to docker group
operator_rules: do not run any forbidden command listed below
redirect every command output to runtime-evidence/M014-S02-vps-forensics.json or .md via tee or shell redirection; never paste secrets into chat
if any command fails or returns a stack trace, capture full stderr verbatim
stop and write a fail-closed blocker if a mutation is accidentally triggered or VPS host identity does not match expected
execution_gate.execution_path: T02 will run commands in the order: C-1 -> C-2 -> C-3 -> C-4 -> C-5 -> C-6 -> C-7 -> C-8 -> C-9 -> C-10 -> C-11 -> C-12

never_print_or_store: POSTGRES_PASSWORD / DATABASE_URL / REDIS_PASSWORD / OPENAI_API_KEY / XIAOMI_API_KEY values
api keys, bearer tokens, raw Authorization headers
allowlisted_to_print: key names present in env (e.g. BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=) but with value SHA-256 truncated
file path, file size, file mtime, permission bits (drwxr-xr-x)
container ID, image ID, image tag (full digest ok; tags are not secrets)
compose config keys (env names) but not values
redaction_policy.redaction_function_reference: scripts/validate_m014_s02_vps_forensics.js must reject any output containing literal redaction targets (regex allowlist)

hypothesis_matrix.policy: S02 verdict (T03) is one of these six outcomes. Each approved command below cites which hypotheses it supports or refutes.

hypotheses.title: Docker / Paperclip data volume wipe or delete
hypotheses.description: A docker volume, compose-managed anonymous volume, or /paperclip data tree was destroyed; runtime evidence would show destroy/remove events, prune/rm commands in shell history, missing named volume, or missing /paperclip/instances/default/companies/<id>.
supports_evidence: shell history with docker volume rm / docker system prune / docker compose down -v
docker volume ls empty for paperclip_sandbox project
refutes_evidence: no prune/destroy events in failure window
no destructive commands in shell history

hypotheses.title: Container destroyed and recreated (data intact)
hypotheses.description: Container was stopped/destroyed and a new container was started without data loss; runtime evidence would show non-zero RestartCount, recent StartedAt / Created post failure-window, multiple die/create events in window, or compose config with non-bind mount storage.
supports_evidence: compose config has no bind mount for /paperclip
container ID differs from any prior captured ID
refutes_evidence: container ID matches prior snapshot if available

hypotheses.title: Auth credentials, session cookie, or admin password drift (no data loss)
hypotheses.description: Credentials, session cookies, or admin password were rotated, expired, or revoked; runtime evidence would show /api/health ok but session 401, missing PAPERCLIP_COMPANY_ID in .env, or the M013-S02-T04 401 pattern.
supports_evidence: session cookie file mtime is recent
refutes_evidence: POSTGRES user table has admin row matching truth map email

hypotheses.title: Filesystem UID / GID ownership drift (bind mount perms)
hypotheses.description: Container filesystem UID/GID changed or bind mount perms mismatched; runtime evidence would show wrong owner on /paperclip or Postgres data dir, Postgres 'permission denied' errors in logs, or compose config mount with mismatched uid.
supports_evidence: compose config mounts without explicit uid mapping
container user != host user for bind mount
refutes_evidence: compose config mounts have uid/gid match

hypotheses.title: nginx / reverse-proxy / ingress config drift
hypotheses.description: Public ingress changed: nginx config drift, BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS missing or wrong, public host 502/403, or Trusted Origin header handling changed; runtime evidence would show nginx config diff in window, missing trusted origin env, or public health 502.
refutes_evidence: nginx config mtime older than failure-window

hypotheses.title: Inconclusive — none of the above can be confirmed
hypotheses.description: Evidence is mixed, partial, or insufficient to commit to a verdict. T03 must write a precise fail-closed blocker explaining the residual unknowns and required next inspection step.

command_groups.title: VPS identity & timing baseline
command_groups.purpose: Establish host identity and current time as evidence anchor; record against which any later claim of staleness can be checked.
command_groups.why_read_only: Pure introspection: reads clock, hostname, uptime, OS release. No filesystem or process mutation.

commands.why: Sets evidence timestamp (RFC3339). Required anti-replay field per slice Q3 controls.
commands.proves: Capture moment so downstream T02 forensics has a freshness anchor.

commands.why: Confirms VPS identity matches known host (previously observed: dwg-conversion-worker).
commands.proves: We are inspecting the correct VPS, not a different sandbox or cloned image.

commands.why: Host uptime corroborates identity and gives a low-cardinality 'no recent reboot' signal.
commands.proves: Whether the VPS itself has been rebooted recently (separate from container restart).

commands.why: OS distro and version; matches expected Ubuntu 24.04 from PAPERCLIP_SANDBOX_TESTING_HANDOFF.md.
commands.proves: Sandbox contract still holds: Ubuntu 24.04 family.

command_groups.title: Docker container identity (H-RECREATE primary, H-WIPE secondary)
command_groups.purpose: Capture current container IDs, image, restart count, and timestamps to test H-RECREATE.
command_groups.why_read_only: docker ps -a and docker inspect are read-only. --no-trunc returns full IDs only (no secrets).

commands.why: List all paperclip-named containers with full IDs. Multiple rows suggest recreate history.
commands.proves: Whether one or more paperclip containers exist; whether any are stopped vs running.

commands.why: Single-line JSON of container timestamps and image. Compare StartedAt against failure-window.
commands.proves: RestartCount > 0 → H-RECREATE; StartedAt > 2026-06-04T09:00:00Z → H-RECREATE post-window; Created pre-window → H-RECREATE not via fresh container.

commands.why: Full container ID and current state.
commands.proves: Live container identity for cross-reference against any prior captured ID.

command_groups.title: Mounts & volumes (H-WIPE primary, H-OWNERSHIP secondary)
command_groups.purpose: Inspect Docker mounts, named volumes, and host bind paths to test H-WIPE.
command_groups.why_read_only: docker inspect, docker volume ls, and docker volume inspect are all read-only. ls on host is read-only.

commands.why: Full mount table for the paperclip container: bind mounts, named volumes, tmpfs.
commands.proves: Whether /paperclip is on a named volume (durable), bind mount, or anonymous volume (non-durable across container recreate). Anonymous or missing mount supports H-WIPE.

commands.why: List all Docker named volumes; project-scoped volumes show as <project>_<name>.
commands.proves: Whether paperclip_sandbox has a named volume at all; absence strongly supports H-WIPE.

commands.command: docker volume inspect $(docker inspect paperclip_sandbox-paperclip-1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Type "volume"}}{{.Name}} {{end}}{{end}}')
commands.why: Detailed metadata for each named volume attached to the paperclip container: driver, mountpoint, labels, scope.
commands.proves: Volume mountpoint path inside /var/lib/docker/volumes/<name>/_data; labels can name the project.

commands.why: List the host sandbox data directory. Allows comparison with PAPERCLIP_SANDBOX_TESTING_HANDOFF.md expected paths.
commands.proves: Whether the host-side data tree exists; absence supports H-WIPE.

command_groups.title: Compose effective config (H-WIPE, H-RECREATE, H-PROXY)
command_groups.purpose: Render effective compose configuration with env file + base + override; verifies whether /paperclip storage is durable and whether auth override env is present.
command_groups.why_read_only: docker compose config prints the resolved configuration without applying it. No service is recreated.
command_groups.redaction_class: low (key names allowed; values not committed)

commands.command: cd /opt/paperclip-sandbox/docker && docker compose -p paperclip_sandbox --env-file /opt/paperclip-sandbox/.env.sandbox -f docker-compose.quickstart.yml -f /opt/paperclip-sandbox/docker-compose.sandbox-override.yml config
commands.why: Renders the same compose stack as the approved safe-restart command, but only as config dump.
commands.proves: Effective volumes, environment, ports. Detects: (a) missing named volume for /paperclip, (b) missing BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS, (c) missing port 3131:3100 binding.

command_groups.title: Docker events in failure window (H-WIPE, H-RECREATE)
command_groups.purpose: Pull docker events filtered to the known failure window from HANDOFF_PAPERCLIP_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.md.
command_groups.why_read_only: docker events only reads the daemon event log; no state change.

commands.why: Events for paperclip container only in the critical window identified by HANDOFF_PAPERCLIP_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.md.
commands.proves: die/destroy/remove/create events in window directly support H-RECREATE or H-WIPE; absence refutes both.

commands.why: Broader sweep covering 2026-06-01 to capture time.
commands.proves: Container/volume lifecycle events across the full incident window; useful when C-5.1 returns empty.

command_groups.title: Docker daemon logs (H-WIPE, H-RECREATE)
command_groups.purpose: Inspect systemd journal for the docker unit; grep for paperclip/volume/destroy/remove/prune/compose/down keywords.
command_groups.why_read_only: journalctl only reads the systemd journal; grep is read-only.
command_groups.redaction_class: low (may contain daemon logs; must be grep-filtered before write)

commands.why: Daemon-level evidence corroborating docker events when daemon-internal actions are not surfaced as container events.
commands.proves: Daemon-side destroy/remove/prune/compose down log lines for paperclip or its volumes; supports H-WIPE or H-RECREATE when present.

command_groups.title: Shell history destructive-command search (H-WIPE primary)
command_groups.purpose: Grep shell history for destructive docker / docker compose patterns. Capture only matching lines, not full history.
command_groups.why_read_only: grep on .bash_history is read-only. Output is pattern-filtered; if a line contains credentials, do NOT record the value (see redaction_policy).
command_groups.redaction_class: high (line must be redacted before write)

commands.command: grep -nE 'docker( compose)? down|down -v|--volumes|volume prune|system prune|docker rm|docker volume rm|docker rmi' /root/.bash_history /home/*/.bash_history 2>/dev/null || echo 'NO_MATCH'
commands.why: Match exact destructive patterns only. Operator rule: any line containing a credential substring is redacted to '<redacted>' before write.
commands.proves: Whether any operator has issued destructive docker commands in the failure window. Strong support for H-WIPE when present.

command_groups.title: Paperclip data directory presence (H-WIPE primary, H-OWNERSHIP secondary)
command_groups.purpose: Inspect /paperclip inside the container for company data directory tree; targets the three known company IDs from S01 truth map §3 plus the R3 stale IDs.
command_groups.why_read_only: docker exec runs the read-only ls and find commands; -lc is a login shell with only -c argument. No mutation.

commands.why: Top-level /paperclip directory listing inside the container.
commands.proves: Whether /paperclip tree exists at all; permission bits for ownership drift signal (H-OWNERSHIP).

commands.command: docker exec paperclip_sandbox-paperclip-1 sh -lc 'find /paperclip/instances/default/companies -maxdepth 2 -type d 2>/dev/null | head -100'
commands.why: Recursive directory walk of companies inside /paperclip, max 100 lines.
commands.proves: Which company UUIDs still exist on disk. Presence of any of 43c74adb-…/1a194762-…/9feb4c22-…/7595fd85-…/7eede16c-…/8233ea7b-… refutes H-WIPE; absence supports H-WIPE.

commands.command: docker exec paperclip_sandbox-paperclip-1 sh -lc 'for id in 43c74adb-b194-44d1-8f8e-ba142544bb9d 1a194762-74b6-4c84-ae3c-d2d8f6f31578 9feb4c22-05b9-401e-ba67-0e866e3056da 7595fd85-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 7eede16c-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 8233ea7b-0000-0000-0000-000000000000; do echo "== $id =="; ls -la /paperclip/instances/default/companies/$id 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING; done'
commands.why: Targeted presence check for the six candidate/stale IDs from S01 truth map §3.2.
commands.proves: Per-UUID existence and ownership on disk; maps presence to H-WIPE / H-RECREATE / H-INCONCLUSIVE.

command_groups.title: Postgres / data layer (H-WIPE, H-OWNERSHIP)
command_groups.purpose: Inspect Postgres data directory and logs for permission or wipe signals.
command_groups.why_read_only: ls -la on /var/lib/postgresql/data is read-only; pg_isready is read-only; docker logs grep is read-only.

commands.why: Postgres data directory listing inside container; ownership bits feed H-OWNERSHIP.
commands.proves: Postgres data dir presence + ownership. Empty or missing → H-WIPE; wrong UID/GID → H-OWNERSHIP.

commands.command: docker exec paperclip_sandbox-paperclip-1 sh -lc 'pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 2>/dev/null || echo PG_NOT_READY'
commands.why: Postgres readiness inside container.
commands.proves: Whether the DB is up at all; supports H-WIPE / H-OWNERSHIP if not ready when container is running.

commands.why: Container log scan for ownership / permission / fatal errors.
commands.proves: H-OWNERSHIP signal (permission/EACCES) or H-WIPE-like (fatal) corroboration in container logs.

command_groups.title: Auth state inspection (H-AUTH-DRIFT)
command_groups.purpose: Inspect admin session artifacts and Paperclip auth-related log lines without printing secret values.
command_groups.why_read_only: ls -la and grep on container logs are read-only. -i flag is headers only, no body.
command_groups.redaction_class: medium (admin email is allowlisted; never print password or cookie value)

commands.why: Admin instance directory listing.
commands.proves: Whether admin session/instance artifacts exist; missing → H-AUTH-DRIFT.

commands.why: Auth-related log lines only; cookie values must be redacted before write.
commands.proves: Recent auth attempts, session resets, or trusted-origin errors; supports H-AUTH-DRIFT.

command_groups.title: Network / proxy / ingress mapping (H-PROXY primary)
command_groups.purpose: Inspect listening sockets, container /etc/hosts, nginx config presence, and public ingress response.
command_groups.why_read_only: ss, ls -la, getent, env (filtered to allowlisted keys), and curl -I are all read-only / non-mutating.
command_groups.redaction_class: medium (env keys allowlisted; values SHA-256 truncated; no Authorization headers)

commands.why: Listening sockets; identifies which processes bind 3131 and 3100.
commands.proves: Whether port 3131 (paperclip-public) and 3100 (paperclip-internal) are bound; helps detect host-level proxy drift.

commands.command: docker exec paperclip_sandbox-paperclip-1 sh -lc 'cat /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; getent hosts paperclip.oysana.com 2>/dev/null || echo NO_RESOLVE'
commands.why: Hosts file and DNS resolution inside container.
commands.proves: Container-internal DNS; absence of paperclip.oysana.com resolution inside container is expected (browser-only public ingress).

commands.why: Nginx config directory listing on VPS.
commands.proves: Whether nginx config files exist; mtime will be checked against failure window for H-PROXY.

commands.command: docker exec paperclip_sandbox-paperclip-1 sh -lc 'env | grep -E "BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS|PAPERCLIP_|ADMIN_" | sed -E "s/=.*$/=<value-sha256-truncated>/"'
commands.why: Container env vars filtered to allowlisted keys; values truncated to SHA-256 fingerprint.
commands.proves: Whether BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS is set and what its hash is; compare against expected http://127.0.0.1:3131.

commands.why: Public ingress health probe with headers only (-I). No cookies sent.
commands.proves: Whether public ingress reaches the container; 502/403 → H-PROXY; 200 → H-PROXY refuted.

command_groups.title: Sandbox env file presence (H-AUTH-DRIFT, H-PROXY)
command_groups.purpose: Confirm sandbox env file exists and record presence/mtime without exposing contents.
command_groups.why_read_only: ls -la and wc -l on file metadata only; contents never printed.
command_groups.redaction_class: high (env file is a secret source; only metadata is allowed)

commands.why: Env file metadata only; never print contents.
commands.proves: Presence + mtime + permission bits of the sandbox env file. mtime recent → possible credential rotation.

commands.why: Line count only, no content.
commands.proves: Size of env file without exposing values.

forbidden_commands.rationale: Destroys named and anonymous volumes; primary cause of H-WIPE.
forbidden_commands.source: HANDOFF_PAPERCLIP_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.md 'Forbidden on VPS unless explicitly approved for destructive recovery'.

forbidden_commands.rationale: Removes all unused volumes; can wipe Paperclip data if mount is anonymous/unused.
Removes unused images, containers, networks; high blast radius.
Removes containers; can orphan volumes and trigger H-WIPE in subsequent recreate.
Removes named volumes directly; direct H-WIPE cause.

forbidden_commands.pattern: docker stop / docker kill / docker restart <container>
forbidden_commands.rationale: Changes runtime state; forbidden in S02 because evidence must be captured before any restart.
Any mutation command inside the container (touch, mkdir, chmod, chown, rm, mv, psql -c, tee, sed -i, >, >>).
forbidden_commands.source: Slice S02 must-haves; Q3 controls enumerate explicit forbidden commands.

forbidden_commands.rationale: Database mutation via exec; forbidden unless explicitly approved.
forbidden_commands.source: Slice S02 must-haves; R3 requires re-verification of UUIDs, not direct mutation.

forbidden_commands.rationale: Ownership/permission mutation; can fake or mask H-OWNERSHIP.
forbidden_commands.source: Q3 controls: forbid mutations before evidence capture.

forbidden_commands.rationale: Any direct filesystem mutation on host or container.
Any Paperclip API mutation; S02 is read-only and S05 is the only slice that may attempt bounded E2E after gates.
forbidden_commands.source: Slice S02 must-haves; MEM053 + GR-001 require explicit human confirmation for every mutation.

forbidden_commands.rationale: Same as F-11 but via SSH tunnel. No mutation before evidence capture.
Remote-fetch + execute is a documented footgun pattern; never permitted.
Daemon-level mutation that erases running daemon events/journal context.
Cron mutation; can schedule destructive jobs later.
When chained to /etc/, /paperclip/, or /var/lib/postgresql/, constitutes filesystem mutation. Allowed only when redirecting command output to runtime-evidence/.
Long-running or interactive commands that block evidence capture and risk exfiltration channels.

evidence_anti_replay.policy: Every captured command output must include anti-replay metadata before being written to runtime-evidence/M014-S02-vps-forensics.json.
evidence_anti_replay.validator_function: scripts/validate_m014_s02_vps_forensics.js (T03) must reject any captured output missing these fields.

fail_closed_when: no explicit user confirmation recorded before T02 execution
any forbidden command from forbidden_commands is run
any command output contains a secret value not redacted
VPS host identity (C-1.2) does not match expected

S02_T03_verdict.must_cite: for each verdict the specific command output that drove the conclusion

S03_lockfile_uses: forbidden_commands list as a runtime check
S04_persistence_canary_uses: C-8.2 /paperclip company tree snapshot as canary target reference

negative_tests_for_t01_packet.rationale: T01 only writes the packet. Negative tests for T01 verify the packet itself: missing commands, missing forbidden list, missing hypothesis mapping, missing redaction policy.
T01_self_checks: every command_group has at least one command
every command has a non-empty why/proves/supports/refutes set
vps_targets_mirror matches truth map vps_targets field-by-field
T02_negative_scenarios_outlined_for_T03_: captured output containing any substring from redaction_policy.never_print_or_store → reject
captured output containing a forbidden command invocation log → reject
verdict cites no command output → reject
